title: First Working Mirror
prompt: Write `async function fastestMirror(urls, fetchFn)` that starts ALL `fetchFn(url)` calls concurrently and resolves with the first value that FULFILLS — a rejected attempt must not win the race. If every mirror rejects, rethrow the last rejection.

tests.name: resolves with the first fulfillment, ignoring rejections
tests.hint: Promise.any resolves with the first fulfillment and only rejects when ALL reject.

tests.name: rethrows when every mirror fails
tests.hint: Promise.any rejects with an AggregateError when every input rejects — just let it propagate.
